purpose: Original illustrative arithmetic for a proposed capability; not an implemented approval or scheduling workflow.
assumptions: Same reviewed specification and commercial cost boundary; all values invented.
Uniform annual quantity over 12 equal months.
New unit price and additional recurring operating cost apply only after go-live.
All stated one-time implementation spend occurs in year one in either scenario.
Dates are input scenarios, not inferred from role capacity or an optimiser.
No tax, discounting, working-capital timing, production scheduling or stochastic ramp model.
Modeled economic effects, not complete cash-flow or accounting results.
Resource availability is already net of existing commitments; do not subtract BAU again.
The original plan remains stored when the current scenario changes.

revised.label: Supplied October scenario; not a computed schedule

evaluation_boundary: Expected answers are public. This is not a blind test. A private application must separately implement input contracts, authority and data handling.
